description: This PHP source file defines the OptionalFieldAPI class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically for the PIM (Personal Information Management) plugin. It provides API endpoints for retrieving and updating configuration related to optional employee fields such as SSN, SIN, tax exemptions, and deprecated fields.

classes.name: OptionalFieldAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints to retrieve and update optional employee field configurations in the PIM module.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve current optional field configuration settings.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update optional field configuration settings.

methods.name: getParameterArray
methods.description: Constructs and returns an array of current configuration parameters for optional fields.

methods.name: saveOptionalFields
methods.description: Saves the provided optional field settings from the request to the configuration service and returns the updated parameters.
